Об игреOne of the best physics based puzzle games in the store! Stack objects and make it steady!

Stones, boxes, bananas - whatever you can imagine. Place all the stuff to make a steady tower and have fun finding the balance. Think over, select and rotate elements, cut the line and drop objects gently.
Find the Balance is a puzzle like game joining an art of stone stacking with easy but challenging gameplay. One of the best physics games you've ever played that you can enjoy with a friend!

Features:
- 100+ levels
- 4 single player game modes (classic, stars, endless, autofall single) 
- 3 multiplayer game modes (adding blocks, speed stack, autofall multi)
- 35+ cutting items to unlock
- many different soundracks to listen to
- unlimited fun placing physical objects
- great physics and balancing challenge
description_short: Stones, bones and bananas - whatever you can imagine. Place all the stuff to make a steady tower and have fun finding the balance in this exciting physics game. Think over, select and rotate elements, cut the line and drop objects gently.
